TARIFF.gloss: a government tax on imports or exports
TARIFF.definition: A government tax on imports or exports.
TARIFF.example: They signed a treaty to lower duties on trade between their countries.

FAIR.gloss: free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception
FAIR.definition: Free from favoritism or self-interest or bias or deception; conforming with established standards or rules.

RIFT.example: The sun shone through a rift in the clouds.

FIAT.gloss: a legally binding command or decision entered on the court record
FIAT.definition: A legally binding command or decision entered on the court record (as if issued by a court or judge).
FIAT.example: A friend in New Mexico said that the order caused no trouble out there.

FART.gloss: a reflex that expels intestinal gas through the anus
FART.definition: A reflex that expels intestinal gas through the anus.

RAFT.gloss: a flat float that can be used for transport or as a platform for swimmers
RAFT.definition: A flat float (usually made of logs or planks) that can be used for transport or as a platform for swimmers.

RIFF.definition: A jazz ostinato; usually provides a background for a solo improvisation.

FAR.definition: To a considerable degree; very much.
FAR.example: A far far better thing that I do.

AIR.gloss: a mixture of gases required for breathing
AIR.definition: A mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of.

ART.definition: The products of human creativity; works of art collectively.

FAT.gloss: a soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids
FAT.definition: A soft greasy substance occurring in organic tissue and consisting of a mixture of lipids (mostly triglycerides).

RAT.gloss: any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse
RAT.definition: Any of various long-tailed rodents similar to but larger than a mouse.

IRA.gloss: belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong
IRA.definition: Belligerence aroused by a real or supposed wrong (personified as one of the deadly sins).

TAR.gloss: any of various dark heavy viscid substances obtained as a residue
TAR.definition: Any of various dark heavy viscid substances obtained as a residue.

FRAT.gloss: a social club for male undergraduates
FRAT.definition: A social club for male undergraduates.
